title: Spring WebFlux WebClient Request Structure
description: Structure documentation for Spring WebFlux WebClient HTTP request configuration.

fields.name: method
fields.description: HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS)

fields.name: uri
fields.description: Target URI for the HTTP request

fields.name: baseUrl
fields.description: Base URL configured on the WebClient instance

fields.name: headers
fields.description: HTTP request headers as key-value pairs

fields.name: queryParams
fields.description: Query parameters to append to the URI

fields.name: body
fields.description: Request body (object, array, string, or null)

fields.name: cookies
fields.description: HTTP cookies to include in the request

fields.name: attributes
fields.description: Request-scoped attributes accessible in filters and handlers
